name: Grok 2.5

release_date.note: weights published (HF repo xai-org/grok-2 created 2025-08-22); README: model trained and used at xAI in 2024

params.note: derived from config and tensor shapes, untied head; active counts unembedding, not the embedding lookup. No official figure; Raschka's gallery says 270B

tokenizer.note: repo ships tokenizer.tok.json; README points to SGLang's tiktoken tokenizer

moe.dense_layers: none; every layer also runs a dense GeGLU MLP of 32768 beside the experts
moe.router: top-2 without renormalisation; router logits tanh-capped at 30

stack.note: every layer: full GQA + 8-expert MoE + dense residual MLP

steps.label: 64 query heads, 8 KV heads; scores tanh-capped at 30
(dense GeGLU 32768 + top-2 of 8 GeGLU experts 16384) / sqrt 2

specials.name: residual_moe
specials.what: dense MLP and routed experts run in parallel; outputs summed and divided by sqrt 2

specials.name: logit_softcap
specials.what: three tanh caps: attention scores 30, router logits 30, final logits 50

specials.name: embedding_scale
specials.what: embeddings scaled by 90.51 (sqrt 8192); head output scaled by 0.5

specials.name: log_length_scaling
specials.what: attention scores multiplied by log(pos) / log(1024) beyond position 1024 (config attn_temperature_len)

readme.note: trained and used at xAI in 2024; Grok 2 Community License; SGLang serving

st.note: no index file; tensor names and shapes read from safetensors headers (byte-range reads): pre/post attn and moe norms, mlp gate/up/down 32768, 8 experts w1/w2/w3, untied lm_head

code.note: Grok1DecoderLayer: four norms, moe_with_rmoe (mlp + moe)/sqrt 2, GeluAndMul tanh, router softcap, YaRN-like ScalingRotaryEmbedding

count.note: 64*(attn 2*d*64*128 + 2*d*8*128 + dense 3*d*32768 + 8*3*d*16384 + router 8d + 4 norms d) + embed V*d + head V*d + final d; active uses 2 experts and drops the embedding

gal.note: entry 'Grok 2.5 270B': date, licence name, cross-check only

kern.note: xai_temperature_len: scores times log2(pos)/log2(1024) once the position passes 1024

figure_links.author: Sebastian Raschka
figure_links.title: Grok 2.5 270B
figure_links.terms: no reuse licence stated; link only

unknowns.ffn.config_activation: config has no hidden_act; SGLang uses GELU (tanh) and-mul for the dense MLP and 'gelu' for experts

notes: Config model_type is 'git' and architecture Grok1ForCausalLM; no transformers implementation, so the order rests on SGLang's code.
Config rope_type 'original' with scaling_factor 16, beta_fast 8, beta_slow 1; SGLang builds a YaRN-style scaled RoPE from these.
